verdict.rationale: TeamViewer ships AI features: an AI troubleshooting assistant, Session Insights, and Tia, which 'learns from every support session'. So the AI-training privacy question applies, but nothing in the evidence documents a way to opt out of having customer data used for model training. The Tia claim, if anything, implies session data feeds the AI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
